name: KCubing Summer 2016

venue.name: First Raytown Baptist
venue.details: Enter in the cafe, turn right at the Gym, and the room will be on your left.

information: Registration Info Registration is $12 for each competitor (includes 3x3) and an additional $2 for each event other than 3x3. Late fee will be charged starting September 1st. Late fee will be $15 for each competitor (includes 3x3) and $4 for each event after that, and you will only be able to register for 3x3, 2x2, skewb, and 4x4. Spectators get in free. No walk in competitors. Register on the CubingUSA site. **lunch** Pizza will be served for $2 a slice. Thank you to TheCubicle.us for sponsoring this competition. Consider checking them out next time you want to order a puzzle. [Directions](https://www.google.com/maps/dir//10500+E+State+Rte+350,+Raytown,+MO+64138/@38.9849374,-94.4588741,17z/data=!4m13!1m4!3m3!1s0x87c0e161caee72d1:0x83aaab1c75d39d09!2s10500+E+State+Rte+350,+Raytown,+MO+64138!3b1!4m7!1m0!1m5!1m1!1s0x87c0e161caee72d1:0x83aaab1c75d39d09!2m2!1d-94.4566854!2d38.9849374) on google maps.
